description: Host request raised when the signer starts an external flow — verification, KBA answer submission or payment (Signing redesign phase 6, SI2). The runner raises it through TmSigningFormRunner.OnExternalStepRequested; with the callback wired the runner stores NOTHING on the click itself — the step completes solely after the host stores the provider result (value true) through TmSigningFormRunner.Values. The Answers carry the inline KBA answers for THIS request only — the runner never stores them as the field value, so a leaked answer cannot complete anything.
